verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Semgrep serves an llms.txt at docs.semgrep.dev that returns HTTP 200 and indexes links to markdown versions of its doc pages. Several doc pages in the pack are themselves served as .md files, such as for-developers/cli.md and writing-rules/overview.md, which gives agents machine-readable docs to consume. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.semgrep.dev/llms.txt # Semgrep
